description: The Peperbus is the tower of the Basilica of Our Lady, a square late-Gothic brick shaft with an octagonal lantern and a copper dome. The dome, put on after the 1815 fire, is why the tower is called a pepper pot. It is not a needle spire. The gallery is empty at this hour. It is clear, about 12.5°C, with wind near 9.0 km/h and cloud cover about 11%. The Sassenpoort is another building and is not in this frame.
